client.installCommand: npm install --include=dev --ignore-scripts; pwd; echo NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV omit=$(npm config get omit) include=$(npm config get include) prod=$(npm config get production); ls node_modules | wc -l; ls node_modules/.bin | head -30; ls node_modules/typescript | head -3; npm run build -w @commander/engine
